meaning: barley tea, a roasted grain drink served hot or cold

example.hakka: 天時當熱，摎我一杯麥仔茶。
example.romanization: Thiên-sṳ̀ tông ngia̍t, lâu ngài yit pî ma̍k-é-chhà.
example.english: The weather is very hot, so give me a glass of barley tea.

note: Barley tea contains no tea leaves, yet Hakka families often boil a big pot in summer to keep the household cool. Hakka uses the suffix 仔 (é) to make a noun, so 麥仔 means barley.
